# Lead Finder

Finds angel investor leads from Crunchbase, enriches emails via Hunter.io, and posts each qualified lead to Slack for review.

## Required env vars (n8n Cloud: Settings → Variables)
```
APIFY_TOKEN=<your apify token>
APIFY_CRUNCHBASE_ACTOR_ID=curious_coder/crunchbase-scraper
CRUNCHBASE_COOKIE=<your crunchbase session cookie>
er/crunchbase-scraper
HUNTER_API_KEY=<your hunter.io key>
HUNTER_MIN_CONFIDENCE=0.9
SLACK_BOT_TOKEN=<xoxb- bot token>
SLACK_CHANNEL_ID=C0ASZ6R2K6E
LEAD_FETCH_LIMIT=3
```

Set `LEAD_FETCH_LIMIT=3` for smoke test, bump to 50 for production.

## How to run
Click **Execute Workflow** manually. Or toggle the Schedule Trigger on to run daily at 6 AM PT.

## What you see in Slack
One message per qualified lead with name, company, email, confidence score, and Crunchbase categories.
